state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the purchase approval threshold for a purchase by the facilities department today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What is the daily meal allowance for an intern on a client-site day in Paris today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q5: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip whose stay includes a Saturday night today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: nightly lodging limit a standard business trip whose stay includes a Saturday night
state.step_intent: Find the nightly lodging limit that applies to: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip whose stay includes a Saturday night today?

passages.source: HB-05 §3 | Travel policy: lodging — Additions | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-01-01 to the day before 2026-05-01 · superseded by: HB-29
passages.text: For a stay that includes a Saturday night, 30 EUR per night was added to the standard nightly lodging limit. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department.

passages.source: HB-29 §3 | Travel policy: lodging — Additions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-05
passages.text: For a stay that includes a Saturday night, 30 EUR per night is added to the standard nightly lodging limit. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.

passages.source: HB-29 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-05
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel is 165 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim.

passages.source: HB-23 §2 | Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions — Exception for business trips to Zurich, Geneva or Oslo | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-01-01
passages.text: For business trips to Zurich, Geneva or Oslo, the nightly lodging limit is 240 EUR per night instead of the standard amount. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment.

passages.source: HB-05 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-01-01 to the day before 2026-05-01 · superseded by: HB-29
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel was 205 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.
